core_obligations: Dispose of p = 0 by the identification of sections of the colimit with the colimit of sections (proof line 3373).

Build a map of systems (F_i, phi_a) to (G_i, psi_a) with each G_i injective and each gamma_i injective, by taking for each i an injection F_i to I_i into an injective sheaf and setting G_i to the product over b: k to i of f_{b,*}I_k, then verifying that the canonical component maps define the transition maps psi_a (proof lines 3376-3401).
Copy the reduction of the quasi-separated colimit lemma to reduce to H^p(X, colim f_i^{-1}G_i) = 0 for p > 0 (proof lines 3403-3406).

Verify that vanishing: it suffices to check Cech cohomology for coverings of a quasi-compact open by finitely many quasi-compact opens, such a covering descends to some X_i, the Cech complex of G is the filtered colimit of the Cech complexes of G_j along the transition maps, each of which is acyclic in positive degrees, and filtered colimits are exact (proof lines 3408-3429).
proof_roadmap: Embed the system into a system of injectives (proof lines 3376-3401).
Reduce to the vanishing of the cohomology of the colimit (proof lines 3403-3406).
Check the vanishing by computing Cech complexes as filtered colimits of acyclic ones (proof lines 3408-3429).
difficulty_reason: In the situation of a directed system of ringed spaces X_i over X with sheaves F_i and transition maps, the lemma computes the cohomology of the colimit F = colim p_i^{-1}F_i on a quasi-compact open pulled back from some X_i as the colimit of the cohomologies H^p(f_a^{-1}(U_i), F_j), hence in particular H^p(X, F) = colim H^p(X_i, F_i) (statement lines 3359-3370). After disposing of p = 0 by the sheaf-theoretic colimit of sections, the author builds an embedding of the whole system (F_i, phi_a) into a system of injective sheaves (G_i, psi_a) by taking products of pushforwards of chosen injectives I_k, which requires checking that each G_i is injective and that the transition maps psi_a are well defined (proof lines 3376-3401). The reduction to the vanishing of H^p of G = colim f_i^{-1}G_i is then copied from the quasi-separated colimit lemma, and the vanishing is checked on Cech complexes of coverings of quasi-compact opens by finitely many quasi-compact opens, which descend to some X_i and where the Cech complex is a filtered colimit of acyclic complexes (proof lines 3403-3429). The claim is H2: no new idea, but three reductions that must be wired together, and the point where filtered exactness is applied is essential.
